summary: Join us as a ‘Public Cloud Support Engineer' at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence.
responsibilities: Provision of technical support for the service management function to resolve more complex issues for a specific client of group of clients.
Execution of preventative maintenance tasks on hardware and software and utilisation of monitoring tools/metrics to identify, prevent and address potential issues and ensure optimal performance.
Maintenance of a knowledge base containing detailed documentation of resolved cases for future reference, self-service opportunities and knowledge sharing.

Analysis of system logs, error messages and user reports to identify the root causes of hardware, software and network issues, and providing a resolution to these issues by fixing or replacing faulty hardware components, reinstalling software, or applying configuration changes.
required_skills: GCP: Proficiency in Compute Engine instance groups, Cloud Storage bucket lifecycle management, VPC subnetting, IAM roles/service accounts, GKE cluster deployment, Stack driver custom logging, and Cloud Functions automation.

AWS: Advanced administration of EC2 (Linux/Windows), ELB, RDS (backup/restore), S3 lifecycle policies, VPC peering, Route53 DNS, CloudFormation IaC, CloudWatch custom metrics, IAM policies, ECS/EKS orchestration.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with CI/CD tools like CloudFormation, Jenkins, Gitlab, Chef, In Spec, and Terraform for automated deployments and infrastructure as code.
Ability to develop automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and custom tools to streamline repetitive cloud operations tasks.
